description: This file implements the RunC container management class and related functionalities, including container creation, execution, state retrieval, and deletion, using the runc command-line tool within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates the execution of runc commands such as create, exec, delete, and state, managing process invocation and output parsing.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container state information including PID and status, parsed from runc's output.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables, loaded from config.json.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds process-specific configuration data such as environment variables for the container.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Implements the container interface for managing a container via runc, including start, stop, status, and resource info.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple RunCContainer instances, providing container creation and lookup functionalities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path using runc create command.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container with optional environment parameters.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the container forcibly using runc delete command.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container, including PID and status.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc in a quiet mode.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates and returns a container object based on configuration found in specified search paths.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Logs container management activities; here, it indicates logging is only at container level.
